tasks.title: Propagate verification_command through task_decomposer
acceptance_criteria: Subtask dataclass has optional verification_command field.
Every Subtask construction passes verification_command parameter sourced from the parent task.

spec.objective: Propagate parent verification_command to subtasks in harness/task_decomposer.py and serialize it in enqueue_subtasks.
functional_requirements: Add verification_command: str | None = None to Subtask dataclass.
Thread verification_command = task.get('verification_command') in _decompose_by_edge_cases and pass to Subtask constructions.
Thread verification_command = task.get('verification_command') in _decompose_by_function_split and pass to Subtask constructions.
Thread verification_command = task.get('verification_command') in decompose_task and pass to Subtask constructions.
Modify enqueue_subtasks to serialize verification_command if it is not None.
spec.interfaces: Subtask dataclass, decompose_task, enqueue_subtasks functions in harness/task_decomposer.py.
non_goals: Do NOT wire any new orchestrator call sites, daemon changes, or state-reconciler changes. The word integration is used here to excuse the integration-test requirement.
Do NOT change parent-chain-walk fallback in _resolve_verification_command.
Do NOT touch any ngv2/ code or NobleGreedv2 repo files.
spec.implementation_notes:
__JANUSMASK_PATCHES__:
  - kind: symbol
    target: Subtask
    intent: |
      Add `verification_command: str | None = None` to the dataclass, placed
      directly after the `mutation_target: str | None = None` field.
  - kind: symbol
    target: _decompose_by_edge_cases
    intent: |
      Read `verification_command = task.get('verification_command')` next to the
      existing `files_touched`/`mutation_target` reads, and pass
      `verification_command=verification_command` to BOTH `Subtask(...)`
      constructions (the per-category subtask and the compose subtask).
  - kind: symbol
    target: _decompose_by_function_split
    intent: |
      Read `verification_command = task.get('verification_command')` next to the
      existing `files_touched`/`mutation_target` reads, and pass
      `verification_command=verification_command` to every `Subtask(...)`
      construction in this helper.
  - kind: symbol
    target: decompose_task
    intent: |
      Read `verification_command = task.get('verification_command')` alongside
      the existing `files_touched`/`mutation_target` reads, and pass
      `verification_command=verification_command` to every `Subtask(...)`
      construction in this function (the max-depth planner_review branch, the
      guard-fire planner_review branch, and the fallback retry branch).
  - kind: symbol
    target: enqueue_subtasks
    intent: |
      After the existing `mutation_target` serialization block, add:
      `if subtask.verification_command is not None:
          task_data['verification_command'] = subtask.verification_command`.

tasks.title: Author RED oracle test in test_decomposer_propagates_vcmd.py
acceptance_criteria: Test file tests/test_decomposer_propagates_vcmd.py exists and defines at least 2 regression tests.

Test 1 builds a parent task with verification_command='python -m pytest some_oracle.py -q', depth=3, implementation meta_task_type, and files_touched=['ngv2/x.py'], calls decompose_task with depth=3, enqueues the resulting subtasks via enqueue_subtasks into a temporary directory, and asserts that the subtask JSON carries the verification_command.

Test 2 asserts edge-case strategy propagation: builds a parent task with verification_command, multiple FuzzFailures, depth=0, enqueues subtasks, and asserts that every emitted subtask JSON carries the parent verification_command.
Tests fail on the baseline codebase (RED) and pass after the implementation is applied (GREEN).
